title: Croatian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring lamb skewers, marinated in a mix of spices and herbs, grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: Croatian spice blend (paprika, salt, black pepper, sugar)
Yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, Croatian spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread lamb, onion, bell pepper, and parsley onto skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
If using red pepper flakes, serve on the side for added heat.
